messages:
incbot: Incident detected: spike in 5xx + timeouts from model-serving runtime 'runner-v2' across us-west-2. Error rate ~7% over last 5m. Paging sre-oncall. :rotating_light:

sre-oncall: on it. grabbing logs and routing info. any customer-facing impact yet?

maria-llm: seeing increased 502/504 from the gateway to runner-v2, also some segfaults in /var/log/runner/runtime.log. sample: 
```
[2026-03-15T10:12:04Z] runner(12456): segfault at 0 ip 0x7f8a1e2f sp 0x7ffd...
[2026-03-15T10:12:05Z] handler: SIGSEGV during attention kernel exec
```

jordan-eng: looks like it's correlated with longer sequences + batches >8. yesterday's canary had a quant-attn change. rolling diff from last deploy: 
`diff --git a/runtime/config b/runtime/config`
`- enable_quant_attn = true`
`+ enable_quant_attn = false`

emily-support: we have a support ticket from AcmeCorp reporting timeouts; priority=high. telling customers we're investigating.

sre-oncall: immediate mitigation: 1) route traffic away from runner-v2 to runner-stable; 2) reduce default batch_size at gateway from 16->8; 3) disable quant-attn feature flag if possible. anyone own traffic reroute?

jordan-eng: I can flip routing policy to exclude runner-v2. doing `kubectl scale --replicas=0 deploy/runner-v2` for now, and update gateway weights.

jordan-eng: executed: gateway weights set runner-stable=0.9, runner-v2=0.1 (we keep small for debug). replicas scaled to 0 for runner-v2 diff.

maria-llm: disabling quant-attn via runtime flag API: `POST /admin/runtime/flags {"enable_quant_attn":false}` — response 200. hooking up log tail.

eng-runtime-bot: Note: 3 pods (runner-v2-4, runner-v2-5, runner-v2-6) reported OOM shortly before segfaults. Memory RSS peaked ~95% of container limit.

tom-infra: I'm checking node-level OOMs and kernel logs. early signs of GPU memory fragmentation + pinned allocations. running `nvidia-smi -q` on node n-az2-3.

emily-support: update for ACME: "We're routing requests to a stable model variant while we investigate a runtime issue causing intermittent errors. No data loss. ETA TBD."

sre-oncall: metrics are down to ~1.2% 5xx after reroute and flag flip. customer impact reduced but not fully resolved. we should keep pager standby for next 2 hours.

jordan-eng: still seeing one of the debug pods crash on startup with same segfault trace when re-enabled. capturing core: `/opt/core/core.runner.12456.gz` uploaded to s3://redwood-incidents/3390012345/core/

maria-llm: hypothesis: quant-attn kernel path triggers an edge-case null deref under high token lengths. backfill failing tests for >2048 tokens.

eng-runtime-bot: Auto-check: latest runner image tag `runner:v2.3.7-quant` differs from stable `runner:v2.3.5` by attention-kernel.c changes.

tom-infra: recommendation: roll back to runner:v2.3.5 on remaining nodes and keep canary disabled. can do quick rollback via rollout restart with image override.

jordan-eng: prepping rollout: `kubectl set image deployment/runner runner=ghcr.io/redwood/runner:v2.3.5 --record`

sre-oncall: action list assigned:
- jordan-eng: rollback runner-v2 -> v2.3.5 (in progress)
- maria-llm: add regression test for quant-attn with >2048 tokens
- tom-infra: check GPU driver logs + watch for node OOMs
- emily-support: update impacted customers + create incident ticket

emily-support: created INC-2026-0456 and posted to status page. pinged 3 customers.

jordan-eng: rollback applied, pods are recreating. monitoring logs.

maria-llm: I see reduced segfaults in new pods. metrics show 0.4% 5xx and tail latency back to normal.

sre-oncall: good. leaving runner-v2 out of rotation until we have a proper fix. we'll keep reduced batch_size 8 as a precaution.

eng-runtime-bot: Note: autoscaler paused for runner deployment to avoid reintroducing canary.

tom-infra: verified no kernel OOMs in the last 30m on affected nodes. GPU mem fragmentation still possible but okay for now.

emily-support: customers updated: ACME, BetaApps, and ZetaLabs informed. ACME moved some traffic to other regions temporarily.

sre-oncall: post-incident notes: cause = quant-attn change in runner:v2.3.7 leading to segfault under specific batch+sequence distribution; mitigation = disable flag + rollback to v2.3.5 + route changes + batch size reduction; impact = brief 7% 5xx spike, affected ~6 paid customers, no data loss.

maria-llm: next steps: codefix in attention kernel, unit/regression tests, canary with smaller batch and token-limits, add monitoring alarm for attention kernel panics.

jordan-eng: I'll open PR for rollback guardrails + add runtime feature flag validation on deploy.

emily-support: I'll draft the customer postmortem blurb for status page + templates for outbound comms.

sre-oncall: great work team. keeping channel open for 1h to watch for regressions; otherwise will archive and start postmortem doc. :thumbsup:

incbot: Incident resolved: 5xx rate returned to baseline and affected runner image rolled back. Incident channel archived in 60m unless new alerts appear.
